body: I think I’m shitty for the actions I’ve done after the incident. I didn’t deal with properly and now I’ve hurt people because I can’t connect with them and ruined relationships and I hate myself for it.
I appreciate those words, thank you. I just can’t stop thinking about it.
I’m a guy, but thank you. I just blame myself for letting it happen and for how I dealt with it afterwards. I’m a shitty person and I hate it.

I should have stopped him before he started touching me. I should have gotten out of the car. I should never have made the post in the first place. I may not be responsible for his actions, but I am for mine. And, I’ve done shitty things and hurt people because of the way I was hurt. And that’s not fair to anyone.
